subject: learning/hermetic-load-lifecycle-tests
statement: ConcurrentLoad retains its process-wide worker budget and real CPU burners, with a private injection seam for owned work and budget in lifecycle tests. Tests hold all admissions in flight to check the shared cap, then hold cancelled burners before exit to prove Run waits for every owned goroutine and returns every budget slot. Process-cancellation fixtures signal readiness before cancellation, including a descendant that inherits output pipes.
intent: Prove bounded load and complete teardown through observable lifecycle transitions.
rationale: Sleeping and comparing process-wide goroutine counts did not identify whether the owned burners had stopped. Explicit entry, cancellation, and exit acknowledgments make that ownership assertion deterministic.
